claims.text: The resort sits on a bluff between the Pacific and the Santa Ynez Mountains in Santa Barbara.

findings.quote: Perched on a picturesque bluff between the Pacific and the Santa Ynez Mountains is our luxury beach hotel in Santa Barbara.
findings.note: Bluff between Pacific and Santa Ynez Mountains in Santa Barbara

claims.text: The architecture is Spanish Colonial Revival, with stucco facades, arched doorways and hand-painted tilework.

findings.quote: Built in Spanish Colonial Revival style, common to this stretch of California, the hotel features stucco facades, arched doorways, and hand-painted tilework.

claims.text: The renovation was led by interior design firm Meyer Davis and added local art and Chumash motifs.

findings.quote: Led by interior design firm Meyer Davis, the updates introduce more local art and Chumash motifs
findings.note: Firm, local art and Chumash motifs stated

claims.text: The Ritz-Carlton Suite is a two-bedroom suite of 2,000 sq ft with a separate living space, fireplace and kitchenette.

findings.quote: A sprawling two-bedroom suite spanning 2,000 sq ft, with two master bedrooms, a separate living space, fireplace, and kitchenette.
findings.note: Size, bedrooms, living space, fireplace, kitchenette all stated

claims.text: The Channel Island Suite is a two-bedroom suite of 3,700 sq ft that suits families or groups of up to eight.

findings.quote: Luxuriate in ultimate comfort in our 3,700 sq. ft. two-bedroom suite, perfect for families or groups of up to eight.
findings.note: Size, two bedrooms, families/groups up to eight stated under Channel Island Suite heading

claims.text: Lulio serves Mediterranean-inspired fare highlighting local produce and sustainable seafood.

findings.quote: Mediterranean-inspired fare highlighting local produce and sustainable seafood at Lulio

claims.text: Marisella is an Italian restaurant serving handmade pastas and wood-grilled seafood.

findings.quote: Marisella blends Amalfi Coast tradition with the richness of California’s land and sea. Savor handmade pastas, wood-grilled seafood and expertly crafted martinis in a beautifully appointed Italian restaurant
findings.note: Italian restaurant with handmade pastas and wood-grilled seafood

claims.text: The resort has four clay tennis courts next to the beach.

findings.quote: The Ritz-Carlton Bacara, Santa Barbara features four clay tennis courts adjacent to the beach
findings.note: Four clay courts adjacent to the beach

claims.text: The resort welcomes dogs weighing 50 pounds or less in its one- and two-bedroom suites.

findings.quote: We are delighted to welcome dogs weighing 50 pounds or less in our one- and two-bedroom Santa Barbara suites.

claims.text: A multi-million-dollar renovation of the resort was completed in July 2025.

findings.quote: Bacara completed a multi-million-dollar renovation in July 2025 that touched nearly every corner of the resort.

claims.text: Families can join guided eco-hikes through the Gaviota Coast foothills and birding and butterfly bike-and-hike adventures.

findings.quote: join guided eco-hikes through the Gaviota Coast foothills, or take part in birding and butterfly bike-and-hike adventures

claims.text: 'O' Bar & Terrace is named for the Chumash word for water and has an open-air loggia with ocean views.

findings.quote: Just beyond the lobby, ‘O’ Bar & Terrace serves modern Latin cuisine, inventive cocktails, and premium agave-based spirits. Named for the Chumash word for water, ‘O’ features an open-air loggia with ocean views

claims.text: Ambassadors of the Environment programs introduce guests to the Gaviota Coast, including kelp forest, birds, the intertidal zone and Chumash culture.

findings.quote: participants in Ambassadors of the Environment can discover the Gaviota Coast’s natural wonders both on land and sea, including kelp forest, a diversity of birds, the intertidal zone, and traditional Chumash culture

claims.text: The resort is about 12 miles north of downtown Santa Barbara, and the city's shops and restaurants are roughly a 20-minute drive away.

findings.quote: the Ritz-Carlton Bacara sits about 12 miles north of downtown Santa Barbara.
Santa Barbara’s shops, restaurants, and broader scene are roughly a 20-minute drive away.

claims.text: The property is set on a hill, and an on-demand jitney cart service helps guests move around.

findings.quote: While the property is set on a hill, guests with disabilities can make use of the resort’s on-demand jitney cart service to move around the property.
findings.note: Hill setting and on-demand jitney stated

claims.text: The resort has a resort fee, which comes with a set of included experiences.

findings.quote: Enhance your stay through a variety of included experiences at The Ritz-Carlton Bacara, Santa Barbara, from Electric Bikes to Guided Beach Tours and more!
